question1.title: How is a Meta Ads campaign structured?
question1.content: Meta Ads is structured into three levels: campaigns, ad sets and ads. Each campaign responds to a business objective and sales funnel stage, and may include multiple ad sets (audiences, placements and budget) and ads. Your campaign structure will be tailored based on your business objectives and resources, focusing on maximizing sales and return on investment.

question2.title: How many Meta Ads campaigns does my business need?

question3.content:
✅ Full management of your Meta Ads campaigns on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp: strategy creation, ad design, Pixel and Conversions API setup, execution, monitoring, data analysis, optimization, and real-time reporting platforms.

❌ It does not include: Meta ad spend, fees for influencers/ambassadors, audiovisual productions, website design, mailing platforms, or CRM tools.

question5.title: Do you offer services beyond Meta Ads?
question5.content:
We specialize exclusively in what we do best: digital advertising under the performance marketing philosophy. Besides Meta Ads, we also manage Google Ads and TikTok Ads campaigns when your strategy calls for it.

If you need services such as branding, website development, or social media content management, we have a trusted partner agency we’ll be happy to refer you to.

question1.title: How is a Google Ads campaign structured?
question1.content: Google Ads is structured into three levels: campaigns, ad groups and ads. Each campaign responds to a business objective and a campaign type (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube or Display), and may include multiple ad groups with their keywords or audience signals. Your campaign structure will be tailored based on your business objectives and resources, focusing on maximizing sales and return on investment.
